Microsoft distribution media shipped with Form virus.

Target: Microsoft Software Media
Repository: N/A
Date: 1995-01-01 to 1995-12-31 (364 days)
Attribution: Accidental
Component: OS / Application
Language:
Cause: Manufacturing error
Motive: Not applicable
Transitive: false
Impact Type: Nuisance
User Impact:
Domain: microsoft.com (project download host)
Artifact Type: floppy disk
Insertion Phase: distribution

Synopsis

In 1995, Microsoft acknowledged accidentally distributing software installation floppy disks (reportedly including some for Windows 95 upgrades) infected with the common 'Form' boot sector virus. The infection likely occurred during mass disk duplication. While not destructive, the virus caused audible clicking sounds on infected PCs on the 18th of the month.

Compromised Versions

  • Specific batches of Microsoft software floppy disks circa 1995 (e.g., Windows 95 upgrade)
